info.name: Onboard External API Gateway auth-oauth ledger-sub-accounts API
Fetch all sub-accounts belonging to the customer.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The ID for the main account for the request.

items.docs: This endpoint helps to create sub-accounts for a customer. The endpoint requires the main account ID to create a sub-account under it.

info.name: Fetch sub-account details by sub-account ID.

params.name: subAccountIdRef
params.description: The unique onboard sub-account ID or reference

items.docs: This endpoint returns sub-account details by sub-account ID.

info.name: Update sub-account details by sub-account ID.

params.name: subAccountIdRef
params.description: The unique onboard sub-account ID or reference

items.docs: This endpoint updates sub-account details by sub-account ID.

params.name: subAccountIdRef
params.description: The unique onboard sub-account ID or reference

items.docs:
This endpoint deletes sub-account by sub-account ID. The sub-account must have zero balance before it can be deleted.
The endpoint will return an error if the sub-account has a non-zero balance. The funds in the sub-account must be transferred to another account before deletion.
Once an account is deleted, it cannot be recovered, and a new sub-account must be created if needed.
The address associated with the sub-account will also be deleted upon successful deletion of the sub-account.

info.name: Get the bank account number for a sub-account.

params.name: subAccountIdRef
params.description: The unique onboard sub-account ID or reference

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency of the bank account number to generate or retrieve.

items.docs:
Returns the bank account number (and bank details) generated for this sub-account in the given
currency, if one exists.

info.name: Create a bank account number for a sub-account.

params.name: subAccountIdRef
params.description: The unique onboard sub-account ID or reference

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency of the bank account number to generate or retrieve.

items.docs:
Generates a bank account number for this sub-account in the given currency through the
account-number provider. The account name must be supplied by the client.
